description: Burn Boot Camp is a group fitness boot camp franchise founded in 2012 in Cornelius, North Carolina. Franchisees operate 3,500-7,000 sq ft facilities offering focused group workouts, nutritional and goal-setting assistance, and the Burn App virtual platform. The 2025 FDD discloses 365 outlets at end of 2024 (356 franchised), a $60,000 franchise fee, $281,899-$645,344 estimated investment, 6% royalty, and 278-outlet Item 19 financials.
territoryDescription: Protected radius: 3-mile radius if fewer than 50,000 people within 3 miles; otherwise the radius yielding a 50,000 population. No marketing/client exclusivity; franchisor reserves broad rights (other brands, channels, national accounts, acquisitions)

risk_score_method.value: base 10 + litigation 8 + capital_intensity 8 + ongoing_fee_load 6 + territory 6 + terminations_2024 4 − item19_coverage 4 − unit_growth 3 − audited_financials 2 = 33
risk_score_method.item: THEORETICAL — method: components: base 10; +8 one settled 2016 state regulatory matter ($15k+$4k, no active litigation); +8 investment ceiling $645,344; +6 royalty 6% + brand fund 2%; +6 protected (not exclusive) territory with broad reserved rights; +4 six franchisee terminations in 2024; −4 Item-19 coverage 278/365=76.2%; −3 net +21 outlets in 2024; −2 audited financial statements attached. Recomputes to 33 exactly.
